article.headline: Army earns 91-52 win against SUNY-Maritime
article.description: — AJ Allenspach scored 20 points and grabbed 12 rebounds as Army beat SUNY-Maritime 91-52 on Tuesday night.

categories.description: SUNY Maritime Privateers @ Army Black Knights

event.description: SUNY Maritime Privateers @ Army Black Knights

keywords: SUNY Maritime Privateers @ Army Black Knights
article.story: WEST POINT, N.Y. -- — AJ Allenspach scored 20 points and grabbed 12 rebounds as Army beat SUNY-Maritime 91-52 on Tuesday night. Josh Scovens scored 16 points and added three blocks for the Black Knights (4-3). Blake Barker had 15 points and went 6 of 8 from the field (3 for 5 from 3-point range). Jovan Germain led the Privateers in scoring, finishing with 21 points. Jake Devaney added 10 points, six rebounds and two steals for SUNY-Maritime. Tyler Anderson also had eight points. Army took the lead with 11:29 left in the first half and did not relinquish it. Allenspach led with 14 points in the first half to help put Army up 51-38 at the break. Army extended its lead to 67-42 during the second half, fueled by a 14-2 scoring run. Barker scored 12 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
